Ironbound.description: Forged in war and hardened by grit, Ironbound warriors don’t rely on magic — their steel speaks loud enough.
perks: Weapon Mastery: bonus damage with melee weapons
Physical Endurance: reduced damage from non-magical attacks
Intimidating Stance: advantage on physical intimidation checks

Embervein.description: Their blood burns with ancient magic — beautiful, volatile, and terrifying in equal measure.
perks: Elemental Affinity (Fire): resistance to fire-based attacks
Volatility: spells may surge in power or misfire unpredictably
Burning Presence: social encounters shaped by awe, unease, or fear

Thorncaller.description: Guardians of wild places and ancient groves, Thorncallers shape nature’s fury and mercy alike.
perks: Beast Speech: communicate with animals via shared instinct
Earthsense Regeneration: regain health near natural terrain
Rootbind: entangle or hinder enemies using surrounding flora

Echoblade.description: Silent steps, quick hands, sharper tongue — the Echoblade isn’t here to make friends. Unless it’s to rob them.
perks: Stealth Attack: bonus damage when attacking from shadows
Sleight of Hand: excels in lockpicking and subtle manipulation
Silvered Tongue: expert in deception, persuasion, and bluffing

Oathbearer.description: Bound by an inner vow — whether divine, personal, or ancestral — the Oathbearer walks the line between blade and belief.
perks: Sense of the Oath: detects nearby corruption or dishonor
Word of Conviction: compels belief or obedience through speech
Radiant Strike: imbue weapon with purifying energy (limited uses)
